jess: Quick question — I noticed a promo credit in the ledger that looks like it expires 2025-06-30 (amount: $25,000). Can we apply this to the Feb hosted invoices or move it to cover Dedicated commitments? :thinking:
ivan: Do you have the invoice IDs and the exact ledger entry? promo vs contract credit matters here.
jess: Yep, here's the CLI snapshot I pulled:```
$ billing-cli credits list --account redwood-prod --filter expiring
ID         TYPE   AMOUNT   EXPIRY      STATUS
PRO-2024-03 promo  $25,000  2025-06-30  usable
CON-2023-88 contract $150,000 2026-01-01 applied
```
jess: Invoices I care about: INV-2025-02-1034 (hosted usage) and INV-2025-02-1035 (dedicated capacity).
sam: Thanks — quick policy note: promo credits are typically only usable against hosted API charges and they auto-apply to open invoices before payment. They can't be converted to reserved-contract credit without a legal/finance adjustment. For Dedicated reserved capacity we usually need a contract credit or a ledger transfer.
mike: Confirming — Dedicated billing runs off the reserved ledger; I don't think promo will auto-offset those charges. We tried that before, AWS billing created a separate invoice.
ivan: OK. Two paths: 1) apply promo to the hosted invoice (INV-2025-02-1034) now — easiest; 2) if customer wants it to pay Dedicated, we open a finance adjustment to convert it to a contract credit (requires approvals). Which does Jess want?
jess: Customer prefers to use it against Dedicated if possible. I'll check with them but want options. If we need an adjustment, what's the exact ask we should put in the ticket?
sam: For conversion request include: invoice ids, ledger entry id (PRO-2024-03), customer contract number, and a note that legal approves conversion. Also include GL codes for the reserved pool (GL: 6452-dedicated-credits). It then becomes a journal entry reversing promo and creating contract credit. CFO approval is required for >$10k.
jess: I'll get legal/CFO signoff if needed.
billing-bot: Automated note — credit PRO-2024-03 is currently in status "usable" and not yet applied to any invoice. To apply run:```
$ billing-cli credits apply --credit PRO-2024-03 --invoice INV-2025-02-1034
```
ivan: If you want me to do the hosted apply, I can run the command now (we'll log the action). If moving to contract, I need a ticket and the signed approval doc.
jess: Please apply to the hosted invoice as interim (customer ok with partial), and I'll escalate conversion request.
mike: After apply, verify hosted invoice balance goes to zero (or reduced) and make sure reserved ledger unchanged. Also patch the deployment billing tag just in case.
sam: I'll pre-create the journal template so we can fast-track if we get the approval. Tag me in the ticket.
jess: Filing ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4721 — attaching CLI output and initial customer confirmation.
ivan: Running hosted apply now.
billing-bot: Action log — applied PRO-2024-03 to INV-2025-02-1034 by ivan at 1748052030. Remaining credit balance: $0.00.
jess: Thanks — customer confirmed they accept hosted offset for Feb while we work conversion for Dedicated. I'll loop back once CFO signoff is in. :thumbsup:
sam: Good. Next steps: jess attach CFO signoff to FIN-4721, finance will prepare journal if conversion approved, ops will confirm reserved ledger unaffected. Closing here until doc attached.
jess: Understood. Marking as "waiting for CFO".
ivan: Noted. I'll leave the audit trail in the ticket.
mike: Leaving a note to watch next month's dedicated invoice for any mismatch.
jess: Thanks everyone.
